messages:
Avery (CSM): Hey everyone — kicking off onboarding for Vireo Labs (primary contact: Priya). Goals: 1) Redwood API integrated for chat+embeddings, 2) 2-week pilot at ~100k tokens/day, 3) be renewal-ready by month 9.
Priya (Vireo PM): Thanks Avery! Stakeholders on our side: Priya (me), Marco (eng lead), Sunita (security). We can do weekly syncs M/W. Can you share proposed deliverables per week?
Avery (CSM): Proposed 6-week plan:
- Week 0: access + security review (API keys, IP allowlist, KMS)
- Week 1–2: integration + smoke tests
- Week 3: perf tuning + batching config
- Week 4: pilot launch
- Week 5: feedback & fixes
- Week 6: handoff + success criteria check
Jade (Solutions Eng): I'll own integration support. Need the sample dataset and expected qps. Can you add Marco to the convo? @Priya please share a staging dataset link or a small dump.
Priya (Vireo PM): Looping in Marco now. Staging data: https://staging.vireo/dump (access expires in 7 days). QPS target ~50 req/s, bursts to 200.
Liam (CS Ops): For burst traffic we'll recommend a Dedicated burst pool or autoscale policy. I'll set up cost alerts and a basic SLO doc.
onboarding-bot: Calendar invite sent: "Vireo Labs Onboarding Kickoff" Tue 10am PT — includes dial-in + preliminary agenda (:calendar:).
Avery (CSM): Two asks before kickoff: 1) Priya confirm security review date, 2) Marco confirm engineer for paired sessions.
Priya (Vireo PM): Security review set for next Tue 3pm PT with Sunita and our compliance team. Marco will be our eng lead for pair sessions.
Jade (Solutions Eng): I'll bring a session checklist: sample requests, repro steps, perf baseline commands. Example perf baseline command:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.infer/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-1","input":"<sample>"}'
```
Avery (CSM): Agreed success criteria: pilot p95 latency <350ms, error rate <0.5%, cost per 1k tokens < $0.80. If met, we move to a quarterly optimization plan and schedule a renewal checkpoint at month 9.
Priya (Vireo PM): Prioritizing latency and stability. Any enablement materials recommended for my PMs/designers?
Liam (CS Ops): I'll drop an enablement deck and a sample eval suite (prompt set + grading rubric) into the shared drive before kickoff, plus a short runbook for incident triage.
Avery (CSM): I'll own the stakeholder scoreboard and post weekly health updates in this thread. Please react with :thumbsup: when aligned or flag blockers.
Priya (Vireo PM): 👍 aligned.
Marco (Vireo Eng Lead): Added — will attend kickoff and lead pair sessions.
Sunita (Vireo Security): We'll cover the KMS integration checklist during the security review and confirm data residency requirements.
Avery (CSM): Great — see you on the invite. I'll post the final agenda and repo link 30m before the call.
